newsitem.title: THAILAND: Padaeng zinc plant expansion on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Padaeng zinc plant expansion on schedule.

text.p: Thai zinc producer Padaeng Industry Plc said on Monday that a plant expansion was on schedule and expected to run at full capacity in March to produce 105,000 tonnes of zinc annually.
The company's refinery in the northern Tak province started its expanded capacity on January 8.
The annual output is expected to rise to 105,000 tonnes once the full capacity is reached from 73,800 tonnes in 1996.

With the expansion, the company is expected to import 150,000-200,000 tonnes of zinc sulphide concentrate to feed its refinery compared with around 140,000 tonnes last year, a company official told Reuters.
Padaeng uses zinc silicate from its own mine in combination with imported zinc sulphide concentrate to cut production costs.
